## Overview

GM-facing document capturing design rationale behind society, economy, and culture decisions in Kythoria.

---

## Design Rationale

Mortal races pushed to brink by 400 years of monster invasion. Society is young (~200 years since Last Stand), forged by survival, still settling. Core principle: **unity through survival**.

## Key Decisions

### Governance  -  Council Accord
- Three Kings (one per capital), meet frequently; any king can invoke formal council
- No single point of failure
- Skywatch: King + Council of Eyes (meritocratic scouts/rangers)
- Emberforge: King + Forgemaster's Circle (guild leaders, craft clans)
- Weaveheart: King + Arcane Conclave (wizards/scholars  -  magocracy in practice)
- Power fluidity: frontier = strength-based; heartland = traditional

### Survival Code (Foundation Law)
5 Articles: Life, Supply, Allegiance, Barrier, Truth. Penalties: labor/exile/execution.

### Economy
- Precious metals = fragments of B (THE big campaign reveal)
- Mint in NE settlement cluster
- Crystal cave beneath capitals supercharges soil fertility (plot hook)
- Industries: mining, smithing, agriculture, arcane, monster hunting, military

### Religion
- 10 gods (7 recognized by Ecumenical Council, 3 banned: Lolth, Raven Queen, Vorn)
- Manufactured divine conflict (gods maintain fake rivalries)
- Ecumenical Council mediates interfaith disputes

### Calendar
10 months x 4 weeks x 5 days = 200 days. Months named after gods (creation order: Kaelthor, Aurelius, Vesper, Aloria, Tyra, Raven Queen, Thalkis, Crassian, Vorn, Lolth). Weekdays: Wildtide, Lawrest, Duskfall, Life-dawn, Fangrest, Gravefall, Sparktide, Cointide, Warmorn, Shadowrest. 8 festivals + Day of Silence.

### Adventurers' Guild
Continent-wide guild called **Drakh Ix'thar** (Draconic for "The Great Dragon Hunt"). Members called **Ix'thari**. HQ in the old capital at the center of the continent. Ranks named in Draconic after legendary beasts, highest: Drah Ix'thari (Dragon Hunter).

---

## Implications
Currency secret is campaign-defining. Manufactured conflict means churches are tools of divine manipulation. Fluid governance creates natural adventure hooks.

## Open Questions
Divine conflict map, settlement naming.
